requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hooking implementation in set_hook_for_httpx and set_hook_for_httpx_async functions does not properly create HTTP2Record instances for new requests. The hooks are not correctly associating with the HTTP records, causing tests to fail with assertion errors related to missing or incorrect HTTP2Record objects.
requirement.contract: The hook functions must create HTTP2Record instances when new requests are initiated and properly associate them with the HTTP records in the records collection. When a new HTTP/2 request is detected (is_new=True in the initiator_and_group tuple), the hook should instantiate an HTTP2Record object with the appropriate parameters and add it to the records collection.

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class doesn't properly handle URL construction from HTTP/2 request headers. The url property in HTTP2Record is not correctly extracting the host and URI information from HTTP/2 headers, resulting in incorrect URL values in test assertions.
requirement.contract: The HTTP2Record.url property must correctly reconstruct the full URL from the HTTP/2 request headers, specifically extracting the host from the ":authority" header and the URI from the ":path" header, and properly handling the scheme based on SSL status.

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class doesn't properly extract method, URI, and protocol information from HTTP/2 request headers. The _parse_first_line method in HTTP2RecordRequest is not correctly parsing HTTP/2 pseudo-headers like ":method", ":path", and ":scheme" to populate the method, uri, and protocol properties.
requirement.contract: The HTTP2RecordRequest._parse_first_line method must correctly parse HTTP/2 pseudo-headers from the raw headers to populate the method, uri, and protocol properties. The method should look for ":method", ":path", and ":scheme" pseudo-headers in the HTTP/2 request headers.

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class does not correctly handle status codes from HTTP/2 responses. The status_code property in HTTP2RecordResponse is not properly extracting the status code from HTTP/2 response headers, causing assertion failures when checking status codes in tests.
requirement.contract: The HTTP2RecordResponse.status_code property must correctly extract the status code from HTTP/2 response headers. It should parse the ":status" pseudo-header from the response headers to populate the status_code property.

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hooking mechanism doesn't properly detect and handle HTTP/2 protocol in the HTTP records management. The hook functions should ensure that when HTTP/2 requests are detected, HTTP2Record instances are properly created and added to the records collection instead of falling back to HTTP1Record.
requirement.contract: The hook functions in httpx.py must detect when an HTTP/2 request is being made and ensure that HTTP2Record instances are created and properly associated with the HTTP records collection. The HTTP records management should distinguish between HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 requests and create appropriate record types.
